Awards are disbursed in two separate installments (one each semester) over the academic year, and may be used for direct school expenses or for living expenses while you are enrolled in an educational program. Awardees will be selected based on: f inancial need; p ersonal circumstance; e ducational path; v ocational or occupational goals; and s ervice, activist, or civic goals. ​ The Foundation will contact awardees only.
